raw_html: [[Absorb Petrification]] - 5 Charges (Recharged/Day: 5)[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Absorb Petrification]]:''' This effect absorbs most [[Petrified|petrification]] spells. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the absorbed energy.
